channels.title: 채널
channels.desc: 메시지 채널 관리 및 플랫폼 연결
channels.agentBindHint: Each Agent can have multiple route bindings (e.g. different accounts or match conditions). Bindings are independent. Complete channel setup in "Channel List" first.
channels.createAgentFirst: Please create an Agent in "Agent Management" first
channels.qqbotDesc: Connect via QQ Open Platform, supports DM and group chat
channels.qqbotGuide1: 前往 QQ 开放平台 创建机器人
channels.qqbotGuide2: 在「开发 → 开发设置」中获取 AppID 和 ClientSecret
channels.qqbotGuide3: You can skip review and test directly in sandbox mode
channels.qqbotGuide4: Add the bot to your QQ group (sandbox channel also works)
channels.qqbotGuide5: Fill in credentials and save; the panel will auto-install the plugin, write config, and restart Gateway
channels.qqbotGuide6: @mention the bot in the group to start chatting
channels.qqbotGuideFooter: 遇到问题？参考 OpenClaw × QQ 常见问题
channels.dingtalkDesc: Connect via DingTalk enterprise internal app, supports DM and group chat
channels.dingtalkGuide1: 前往 钉钉开放平台，创建「企业内部应用」
channels.dingtalkGuide2: Enable Robot capability under "App Features → Robot"
channels.dingtalkGuide3: Set message receive mode to Stream Mode (recommended)
channels.dingtalkGuide4: Get Client ID (AppKey) and Client Secret (AppSecret) from credentials page
channels.dingtalkGuide6: Publish the app version, then add the bot to the target group
channels.dingtalkGuide7: Fill in credentials and save; the panel will auto-install the plugin and restart Gateway
channels.dingtalkGuideFooter: 注意：Stream 模式需要钉钉服务端主动推送，确保网络可达
channels.feishuDesc: Connect via Feishu custom enterprise app, supports DM and group chat
channels.feishuGuide1: 前往 飞书开放平台 创建企业自建应用
channels.feishuGuide3: Get App ID and App Secret from credentials page
channels.feishuGuide4: Select "Long Connection" for event callback (no public IP needed)
channels.feishuGuide5: 权限管理中搜索并开通 im:message、im:message.group_at_msg 等消息权限
channels.feishuGuide6: Create a version, publish, then add the bot to the target group
channels.feishuGuideFooter: 推荐使用长连接方式，无需公网地址即可接收消息
channels.telegramDesc: Connect a Telegram Bot, supports DM and groups
channels.telegramGuide1: 在 Telegram 中搜索 @BotFather 并发送 /newbot
channels.telegramGuide2: Follow prompts to set bot name and username
channels.telegramGuide3: Copy the Bot Token returned by BotFather
channels.telegramGuide4: Fill in credentials below and save
channels.telegramGuideFooter: 需要公网可达的服务器或使用 polling 模式
channels.zaloDesc: Connect Zalo Bot API for DM and group messaging in Vietnam-focused scenarios
channels.zaloGuide1: Open Zalo Bot Platform and create or open your bot
channels.zaloGuide2: Get the Bot Token; if you use SecretRef or an external file, fill Token File instead
channels.zaloGuide3: For webhook mode, fill Webhook URL / Secret / Path; otherwise leave them empty for the default receive mode
channels.zaloGuide4: Set DM policy, group policy, and allowlists; after saving, the panel installs the plugin and reloads Gateway
channels.zaloGuide5: If messages do not arrive, confirm the bot is enabled on Zalo and inspect Gateway logs
channels.zaloGuideFooter: Zalo Bot requires either Bot Token or Token File.
channels.zaloBotTokenHint: Use either this or Token File; keep the SecretRef placeholder unchanged to preserve the reference.
channels.zaloTokenFileHint: Use this when the token is file-managed; online verification only checks Bot Token directly and will not read external files.
channels.zaloWebhookSecretPh: Webhook Secret with at least 8 characters
channels.zaloAllowFromHint: Numeric user IDs are recommended for Zalo Bot; leave empty to use policy defaults.
channels.zaloGroupAllowFromPh: Optional, comma-separated group or thread IDs
channels.groupAllowFromHint: Restrict allowed group or thread IDs; leave empty for no restriction.
channels.zalouserDesc: Connect a Zalo personal account via QR login, with DM and group support
channels.zalouserGuide1: Install the @openclaw/zalouser plugin first; the panel will try to install it on save
channels.zalouserGuide2: After saving, run openclaw channels login --channel zalouser and scan with the Zalo mobile app
channels.zalouserGuide3: For multi-account setup, fill Account Identifier and add --account account-id to the command
channels.zalouserGuide4: Numeric IDs are recommended for Allow From / Group Allow From; name matching is risky and disabled by default
channels.zalouserGuide5: If login state is unhealthy, run openclaw channels logout --channel zalouser and log in again
channels.zalouserGuideFooter: Zalo Personal is an unofficial personal-account automation integration and may carry account risk. Use carefully.
channels.zalouserProfileHint: Leave empty for default; for multi-account setup, match the account identifier, e.g. work.
channels.zalouserNameMatchingHint: When disabled, only stable IDs are matched to avoid wrong matches with duplicate names.
channels.zalouserAllowFromPh: Optional, comma-separated user IDs or exact names
channels.zalouserAllowFromHint: Zalo user IDs are recommended; enable name matching only when you understand the risk.
channels.zalouserGroupAllowFromPh: Optional, comma-separated group IDs or exact group names
channels.zalouserManualLoginHint: After installing the plugin and saving config, run this command in your terminal to complete QR login. For multi-account setup, append --account account-id.
channels.lineDesc: Connect LINE Messaging API with DM, group, and webhook support
channels.lineGuide1: Open LINE Developers Console and create or open a Messaging API Channel
channels.lineGuide2: Get Channel Access Token from Messaging API and Channel Secret from Basic settings
channels.lineGuide3: If credentials are managed by files or SecretRef, use Token File and Secret File instead
channels.lineGuide4: Set the Webhook URL to the Gateway LINE webhook path and enable Webhook in LINE Console
channels.lineGuide5: Set DM/group policy and allowlists; after saving, the panel installs the plugin and reloads Gateway
channels.lineGuideFooter: LINE requires either Channel Access Token or Token File, and either Channel Secret or Secret File.
channels.lineAccessTokenHint: Use either this or Token File; keep the SecretRef placeholder unchanged to preserve the reference.
channels.lineTokenFileHint: Use this when Channel Access Token is file-managed; online verification only checks the form token directly.
channels.lineChannelSecretHint: Use either this or Secret File; used to verify LINE webhook signatures.
channels.lineSecretFileHint: Use this when Channel Secret is file-managed.
channels.lineAllowFromHint: LINE user IDs usually start with U; leave empty to use policy defaults.
channels.lineGroupAllowFromPh: Optional, comma-separated group or room IDs
channels.lineTokenOrFile: Channel Access Token or Token File
channels.mattermostDesc: Connect self-hosted Mattermost with DMs, channels, slash commands, and interactions
channels.mattermostGuide1: Create a Bot Account in Mattermost and copy its Personal Access Token as Bot Token
channels.mattermostGuide2: Fill the Mattermost site Base URL, for example https://mattermost.example.com
channels.mattermostGuide3: If slash commands are enabled, configure Callback Path / URL and ensure the Mattermost server can reach Gateway
channels.mattermostGuide4: For self-hosted private-network URLs, explicitly enable Private Network to avoid unsafe internal access
channels.mattermostGuide5: Set DM/channel policy and allowlists; after saving, the panel installs the plugin and reloads Gateway
channels.mattermostGuideFooter: Mattermost minimally requires Bot Token and Base URL.
channels.mattermostBaseUrlHint: Use the site root URL without /api/v4; trailing slash is normalized at runtime.
channels.mattermostAllowFromPh: Optional, comma-separated usernames or user IDs
channels.mattermostAllowFromHint: Usernames may include @; choosing Allow all DMs automatically adds *.
channels.mattermostGroupAllowFromPh: Optional, comma-separated channel IDs or channel names
channels.mattermostCallbackPathHint: Gateway HTTP path for slash command and interaction callbacks.
channels.mattermostNameMatchingHint: When disabled, prefer stable IDs to avoid wrong matches with duplicate users or channels.
channels.mattermostPrivateNetworkHint: Enable only when Mattermost is deployed on a trusted private network.
channels.clickclackDesc: Connect a self-hosted ClickClack workspace with channel, thread, and DM targets
channels.clickclackGuide1: Make sure ClickClack is deployed and reachable by Gateway, then copy the workspace Base URL
channels.clickclackGuide2: Prepare the access Token and Workspace identifier; for multi-account setup, use an account id such as work
channels.clickclackGuide4: After saving, the panel enables the bundled ClickClack plugin and reloads Gateway; verify connectivity through Gateway logs or channels status
channels.clickclackGuideFooter: ClickClack minimally requires Base URL, Token, and Workspace.
channels.clickclackBaseUrlHint: Use the ClickClack service root URL, for example https://clickclack.example.com.
channels.clickclackWorkspaceHint: Workspace must match the ClickClack server configuration.
channels.clickclackSystemPromptPh: Optional system prompt override for this channel
channels.clickclackTimeoutHint: Request timeout in seconds; upstream allows 1 to 3600.
channels.clickclackToolsAllowHint: Optional comma-separated tool names allowed for this channel.
channels.clickclackSenderIsOwnerHint: Treat the ClickClack sender as owner when enabled; use only in trusted internal workspaces.
channels.clickclackDefaultToHint: Default target, e.g. channel:general, thread:123, or dm:alice.
channels.clickclackAllowFromHint: Optional comma-separated allowed sources; leave empty for upstream defaults, * allows all.
channels.nextcloudTalkDesc: Connect self-hosted Nextcloud Talk with DMs, rooms, and webhook callbacks
channels.nextcloudTalkGuide1: Create a bot in Nextcloud Talk administration and copy the Bot Secret
channels.nextcloudTalkGuide2: Fill the Nextcloud site Base URL, for example https://cloud.example.com
channels.nextcloudTalkGuide3: To let the panel probe bot capabilities, provide API User plus an app password or password file
channels.nextcloudTalkGuide4: After saving, the panel enables the bundled Nextcloud Talk plugin and reloads Gateway; verify connectivity through Gateway logs or channels status
channels.nextcloudTalkGuideFooter: Nextcloud Talk minimally requires Base URL plus either Bot Secret or Secret File.
channels.nextcloudTalkBaseUrlHint: Use the Nextcloud site root URL without Talk API paths; upstream normalizes trailing slashes.
channels.nextcloudTalkBotSecretHint: For production, prefer Secret File or SecretRef to avoid plain-text config secrets.
channels.nextcloudTalkBotSecretFileHint: Path to the Bot Secret file; use this or Bot Secret.
channels.nextcloudTalkApiPasswordHint: Optional; used for admin API probes of the bot response feature.
channels.nextcloudTalkWebhookPublicUrlHint: Public or reverse-proxy URL reachable by Nextcloud, usually the panel/Gateway webhook URL.
channels.nextcloudTalkAllowFromHint: Optional comma-separated user IDs allowed for DMs; choosing Allow all DMs automatically adds *.
channels.nextcloudTalkPrivateNetworkHint: Enable only when Nextcloud runs on a trusted private network reachable by Gateway.
channels.twitchDesc: Connect Twitch chat with channel messages, role filters, and OAuth token settings
channels.twitchGuide1: Create an app in the Twitch developer console and copy the Client ID
channels.twitchGuide2: Prepare an OAuth access token for the bot account with at least chat:read and chat:write scopes
channels.twitchGuide3: Fill the bot username and target channel; the channel can be entered without #
channels.twitchGuide4: After saving, the panel installs the Twitch plugin and reloads Gateway; verify connectivity through Gateway logs or channels status
channels.twitchGuideFooter: Twitch minimally requires Username, Access Token, Client ID, and Channel.
channels.twitchUsernameHint: Bot login name, usually the Twitch username without @.
channels.twitchAccessTokenHint: OAuth access token; oauth: prefix is allowed. Prefer SecretRef in production.
channels.twitchClientIdHint: Application Client ID from the Twitch developer console.
channels.twitchChannelHint: Target chat channel, e.g. openclaw or #openclaw.
channels.twitchAllowFromHint: Optional comma-separated Twitch user IDs allowed to start conversations.
channels.twitchAllowedRolesHint: Optional comma-separated roles: moderator, owner, vip, subscriber, all.
channels.twitchClientSecretHint: Optional; only needed for OAuth flows that refresh tokens.
channels.twitchRefreshTokenHint: Optional; used with Client Secret to refresh the access token.
channels.twitchObtainmentTimestampHint: Token obtainment timestamp; upstream uses it to decide refresh timing.
channels.nostrDesc: Connect Nostr direct messages with relay lists, DM access policy, and public profile settings
channels.nostrGuide1: Prepare the bot account Nostr private key, using nsec or 64-character hex format
channels.nostrGuide2: Fill relay URLs reachable by Gateway; separate multiple URLs with commas
channels.nostrGuide3: Set DM Policy and Allow From as needed to limit which npub or public keys can start DMs
channels.nostrGuide4: After saving, the panel enables the Nostr plugin and reloads Gateway; verify connectivity through Gateway logs or channels status
channels.nostrGuideFooter: Nostr minimally requires Private Key; upstream uses default relays when Relay URLs are empty.
channels.nostrPrivateKeyHint: Prefer SecretRef in production; plain-text private keys are written to openclaw.json.
channels.nostrRelaysHint: Use ws:// or wss:// relay URLs; separate multiple values with commas, semicolons, or new lines.
channels.nostrAllowFromHint: Optional comma-separated npub or 64-character public keys allowed to start DMs; used when dmPolicy=allowlist.
channels.nostrDefaultAccountHint: Upstream currently derives an implicit account from the root config; default is usually enough.
channels.nostrProfileAboutPh: Optional bot introduction shown in the Nostr profile
channels.nostrProfileUrlHint: Upstream profile URL fields require https:// URLs.
channels.tlonDesc: Connect Tlon / Urbit messaging with ship login, group channels, DM allowlists, and invite controls
channels.tlonGuide1: Prepare a reachable Tlon ship, for example ~sampel-palnet, and make sure Gateway can access its URL
channels.tlonGuide2: Fill Ship, URL, and login Code; these are the minimum fields required by the upstream Tlon plugin
channels.tlonGuide3: Set Group Channels, DM Allowlist, and Group Invite Allowlist as needed to limit where the bot can respond and accept invites
channels.tlonGuide4: After saving, the panel enables the Tlon plugin and reloads Gateway; verify connectivity through Gateway logs or channels status --probe
channels.tlonGuideFooter: Tlon minimally requires Ship, URL, and Code; named accounts are written to channels.tlon.accounts, while the default account is written to the channels.tlon root.
channels.tlonShipHint: Ship names usually start with ~, for example ~sampel-palnet.
channels.tlonUrlHint: Tlon instance URL; https:// is recommended. For private addresses, make sure Gateway can reach it.
channels.tlonCodeHint: Tlon login code; prefer SecretRef in production. Keep the SecretRef placeholder unchanged to preserve the reference.
channels.tlonPrivateNetworkHint: Enable only for trusted private Tlon URLs; this writes network.dangerouslyAllowPrivateNetwork.
channels.tlonGroupChannelsHint: Group channel nests separated by commas, for example chat/~host-ship/general.
channels.tlonDmAllowlistHint: Ships allowed to start DMs, separated by commas.
channels.tlonGroupInviteAllowlistHint: Ships allowed to invite the bot to groups; leave empty to use upstream defaults.
channels.tlonAutoDiscoverChannelsHint: When enabled, upstream tries to discover available channels; for large ships, explicitly setting Group Channels first is recommended.
channels.tlonAutoAcceptDmInvitesHint: Usually use this with DM Allowlist to avoid accepting unknown ships.
channels.tlonAutoAcceptGroupInvitesHint: Configure Group Invite Allowlist as well to avoid malicious group invites.
channels.tlonOwnerShipHint: Owner ship that receives approval requests; use the current ship or a dedicated management ship.
channels.tlonDefaultAuthorizedShipsHint: Default authorized ships separated by commas.
channels.ircDesc: Connect IRC networks with server accounts, NickServ login, channel allowlists, and mention policy
channels.ircGuide1: Prepare the IRC server host, for example irc.libera.chat, and make sure Gateway can connect
channels.ircGuide2: Fill the bot Nick; if the server requires SASL or a password, provide Server Password or a file path
channels.ircGuide3: If the account is registered, enable NickServ and provide password or password file; enable Register only when automatic registration is needed
channels.ircGuide4: Fill auto-join channels and allowed channels; after saving, the panel installs the IRC plugin and reloads Gateway
channels.ircGuideFooter: IRC minimally requires Host and Nick; verify real connectivity through Gateway logs or channels status.
channels.ircHostHint: IRC server host name without the irc:// prefix.
channels.ircPortHint: Common TLS port is 6697; common non-TLS port is 6667.
channels.ircTlsHint: Recommended when connecting to servers that support TLS.
channels.ircNickHint: Bot nickname on the IRC network; it must satisfy server nickname rules.
channels.ircPasswordHint: Server connection password or SASL password; prefer SecretRef in production.
channels.ircPasswordFileHint: Path to the server password file; use this or Server Password.
channels.ircNickservHint: Used to identify a registered nick with NickServ; supports plain text, SecretRef, or password file.
channels.ircNickservRegisterHint: Enable only when the server allows bot auto-registration.
channels.ircChannelsHint: Channels to auto-join after connect; use # prefixes and separate multiple values with commas.
channels.ircGroupsHint: Channels where the bot may respond; Require Mention is written into each channel config.
channels.ircGroupAllowFromHint: Optional nick or hostmask allowlist for channel messages.
channels.ircMentionPatternsHint: Additional mention patterns, for example openclaw: or @openclaw.
channels.ircNameMatchingHint: Enable only when stable hostmasks are unavailable; duplicate nicks can be matched incorrectly.
channels.synologyChatDesc: Connect Synology Chat for NAS-hosted team messaging
channels.synologyChatGuide1: Create a bot in Synology Chat administration and copy its Token
channels.synologyChatGuide2: Configure an Incoming Webhook or bot post URL, then paste it as Incoming URL
channels.synologyChatGuide3: Configure the Outgoing Webhook path in Synology Chat; /webhook/synology is recommended
channels.synologyChatGuide4: Save, reload Gateway, then test from the target channel
channels.synologyChatGuideFooter: For private NAS networks, make sure Gateway can reach the NAS host.
channels.synologyChatIncomingUrlHint: Synology Chat Incoming Webhook URL used to send bot replies
channels.synologyChatAllowedUserIdsHint: Comma-separated DM allowlist user IDs; used when dmPolicy=allowlist
channels.synologyChatNameMatchingHint: Use only when stable user IDs are unavailable; IDs are safer
channels.synologyChatInheritedWebhookPathHint: Enable when multiple accounts share the root webhookPath
channels.synologyChatAllowInsecureSslHint: Use only for self-signed certificates or trusted internal testing
channels.googleChatDesc: Connect a Google Chat App for spaces and direct messages
channels.googleChatGuide1: Create a Chat App in Google Cloud and enable the Google Chat API
channels.googleChatGuide2: Create a Service Account, then download its JSON file or prepare inline JSON
channels.googleChatGuide3: Configure the Google Chat callback URL and set audienceType plus audience
channels.googleChatGuide4: Save, reload Gateway, then invite the app to a target Space for testing
channels.googleChatGuideFooter: Prefer Service Account File in production to avoid storing long JSON inline.
channels.googleChatServiceAccountFileHint: Path to the Service Account JSON file; recommended for production
channels.googleChatServiceAccountHint: Paste Service Account JSON inline; it will be written to openclaw.json
channels.googleChatServiceAccountRefHint: Preserve or enter an existing SecretRef, e.g. SecretRef(env:default:GOOGLE_CHAT_SERVICE_ACCOUNT)
channels.googleChatAudienceHint: Use callback URL for app-url mode; use Google Cloud project number for project-number mode
channels.googleChatAllowFromHint: DM allowlist, using users/<id> or email entries separated by commas
channels.googleChatGroupAllowFromHint: Space allowlist, using spaces/<id> entries separated by commas
channels.googleChatNameMatchingHint: Stable IDs are preferred; enable only when email/name matching is required
channels.discordDesc: Connect a Discord Bot, supports server channels and DMs
channels.discordGuide1: 前往 Discord Developer Portal 创建 Application
channels.discordGuide2: Click "Reset Token" on the Bot page to get the Bot Token
channels.discordGuide4: Use OAuth2 URL Generator to invite the Bot to your server
channels.discordGuideFooter: 确保开启 Message Content Intent 以接收消息内容
channels.slackDesc: Connect a Slack App, supports channels and DMs
channels.slackGuide1: 前往 Slack API 创建 App（推荐 From a manifest）
channels.slackGuide2: Add Bot Token Scopes in OAuth & Permissions: chat:write, app_mentions:read, etc.
channels.slackGuide3: Install the App to your workspace and get the Bot Token (xoxb-)
channels.slackGuide4: Socket Mode: Enable Socket Mode in Basic Information and get the App-Level Token (xapp-)
channels.slackGuide5: HTTP Mode: Fill in the Request URL under Event Subscriptions
channels.slackGuideFooter: Socket Mode 无需公网地址；HTTP Mode 需要配置事件回调 URL
channels.slackSigningSecretHint: Used to verify request signatures in HTTP Mode
channels.allowFromHint: Restrict to specific user or channel IDs; leave empty for no restriction
channels.weixinDesc: Connect personal WeChat via the openclaw-weixin plugin
channels.weixinGuide1: This feature is powered by the openclaw-weixin plugin
channels.weixinGuide3: After installation, click "Scan to Login" and scan the QR code with your phone
channels.weixinGuide4: Once logged in, Gateway will automatically handle messages
channels.weixinGuideFooter: 注意：个人微信接入存在风控风险，建议使用小号
channels.weixinInstallHint: Auto-download and install the openclaw-weixin plugin
channels.weixinLoginHint: Start the WeChat login flow; messages are handled after scanning
channels.weixinScanQr: Scan this QR code with WeChat on your phone
channels.msteamsGuide1: 在 Azure Portal 注册 Bot Channel Registration
channels.msteamsGuide3: Install the custom App in Teams
channels.msteamsGuideFooter: 需要 Azure AD 应用注册和 Teams 管理员权限
channels.msteamsAppPasswordHint: Required for Client Secret mode; leave empty for Federated / Managed Identity
channels.msteamsGroupAllowFromPh: Optional, comma-separated Team or Channel IDs
channels.signalGuide1: 安装 signal-cli 并注册/链接账号
channels.signalGuide2: Ensure signal-cli can send and receive messages
channels.signalGuide3: Fill in account info and signal-cli path
channels.signalGuideFooter: 需要本地安装 signal-cli 并完成账号注册
channels.imessageDesc: Connect iMessage / SMS bridge from a local or remote Mac
channels.imessageGuide1: Install the iMessage bridge plugin on a macOS device that can access the Messages database
channels.imessageGuide2: Confirm the bridge CLI can read chat.db and send iMessage or SMS when needed
channels.imessageGuide3: Fill remote host, allowlists, attachment roots, and history windows as needed
channels.imessageGuide4: Save, restart or reload Gateway, then check bridge status in channel diagnostics
channels.imessageGuideFooter: iMessage does not need a Bot Token; runtime health depends on bridge process permissions on the local or remote Mac
channels.imessageCliPathPh: Optional, defaults to PATH lookup for the bridge CLI
channels.imessageAllowFromPh: Optional, comma-separated phone numbers, emails, or contact IDs
channels.matrixDesc: Connect via Matrix protocol (Element and other clients)
channels.matrixGuide1: Register a Bot account on a Matrix server
channels.matrixGuide2: Get an Access Token (or use username & password)
channels.matrixGuide3: Invite the Bot to the target room
channels.matrixGuideFooter: 支持任何兼容 Matrix 协议的服务器
channels.matrixAccessTokenHint: Use either Access Token or User ID + Password
channels.matrixPasswordPh: Leave empty when using Access Token
channels.matrixAuthRequired: Matrix requires an Access Token, or User ID + Password

channels.whatsappDesc: Connect a WhatsApp personal account via QR login, with DM, group, and local session runtime options
channels.whatsappGuide1: Install the @openclaw/whatsapp plugin first; the panel will try to enable it on save

engine.hermesSessionRuntimeDesc: Control automatic session reset and group chat isolation to reduce context bleed, accidental interrupts, and long-running context growth.
engine.hermesSessionRuntimeSaveSuccess: Session settings saved. Restart Hermes Gateway to take effect.
engine.hermesSessionResetMode_both: Idle or daily, whichever comes first
engine.hermesWorktreeEnabled: Use Git worktree isolation for CLI sessions by default
engine.hermesSessionRuntimeFootnote: Keeping group isolation on is recommended. For multi-user or multi-agent long runs in the same repository, enable worktree isolation to reduce file conflicts.
engine.hermesSessionsMaintenanceDesc: Control state.db auto-pruning, VACUUM, and legacy JSON snapshot writing so unattended long runs do not keep growing the session store and disk usage.
engine.hermesSessionsMaintenanceSaveSuccess: Session store maintenance settings saved. Restart Hermes Gateway to take effect.
engine.hermesSessionsMaintenanceFootnote: This writes sessions.*. Auto-prune only touches ended sessions; active sessions are preserved by Hermes. VACUUM reclaims disk after deletes but may briefly block writes. Legacy JSON snapshots are off by default; enable them only if an external tool reads ~/.hermes/sessions/session_*.json directly.
engine.hermesUpdatesConfigDesc: Control whether hermes update creates a full backup first, and cap how many pre-update backups are retained to reduce recovery cost after failed updates.
engine.hermesUpdatesConfigSaveSuccess: Pre-update backup settings saved. Restart Hermes Gateway to take effect.
engine.hermesUpdatesConfigPreUpdateBackup: Create a full backup before hermes update
engine.hermesUpdatesConfigFootnote: This writes updates.*. Backups are stored under <HERMES_HOME>/backups/ and large homes may add minutes to each update. Keep count must be at least 1; turn the switch off to disable pre-update backups instead of entering 0. Other advanced updates fields stay in raw YAML.
engine.hermesTerminalConfigDesc: Control command execution backend, working directory, timeouts, and container resources to avoid stuck runs or sandbox misconfiguration.
engine.hermesTerminalConfigSaveSuccess: Terminal execution settings saved. Restart Hermes Gateway to take effect.
engine.hermesTerminalConfigPersistentShell: Keep persistent shell for remote and sandbox backends
engine.hermesTerminalConfigFootnote: Shell init files use one path per line and support ~ plus ${VAR} placeholders. Leaving the list blank removes shell_init_files so Hermes uses its automatic startup-file sourcing behavior. Sandbox env passthrough and Docker env forwarding store variable names only, not secret values. Explicit Docker env writes values into the container environment; avoid storing plaintext secrets in shared config. docker_volumes and docker_extra_args only apply to the Docker backend and can expose host paths or change container isolation, so enable them only when needed. SSH fields only apply to the SSH backend. Leaving them blank removes host, user, and key overrides; the panel does not save SSH passwords. Image fields only apply to the matching Docker, Singularity, Modal, or Daytona backend. Leaving them blank removes the override and uses Hermes defaults. Modal runtime mode and Vercel runtime write upstream terminal.modal_mode / terminal.vercel_runtime; keep them aligned with the actual cloud sandbox account. Mounting the launch cwd exposes host files to the sandbox; enable it only for trusted projects or unattended jobs.
engine.hermesStreamingConfigDesc: Control whether Hermes Gateway updates messages while replies are generated, plus the refresh cadence. Useful when channels need quicker progress for long replies.
engine.hermesStreamingConfigSaveSuccess: Streaming settings saved. Restart Hermes Gateway to take effect.
engine.hermesStreamingConfigFootnote: This writes the top-level streaming settings. Legacy gateway.streaming, display.streaming, and other advanced fields are preserved in raw YAML. Set fresh final message time to 0 to disable the final follow-up message.
engine.hermesExecutionLimitsDesc: Control execute_code sandbox and delegate_task child-agent timeouts, concurrency, depth, and auto-approval policy to reduce runaway long-run tasks and cost amplification.
engine.hermesExecutionLimitsSaveSuccess: Execution and delegation limits saved. Restart Hermes Gateway to take effect.
engine.hermesExecutionLimitsLoadFailed: Load execution and delegation limits failed
engine.hermesExecutionLimitsSaveFailed: Save execution and delegation limits failed
engine.hermesExecutionLimitsFootnote: Leave child model and provider blank to inherit the parent task. Fill them only to reduce cost, isolate slower models, or pin child-task routing. By default, dangerous-command approvals from child agents are auto-denied, which fits interactive and long-running tasks. Enable auto-approval only in fully trusted unattended environments.
engine.hermesIoSafetyDesc: Limit single file reads and tool output size so large files or long logs do not flood the context.
engine.hermesIoSafetySaveSuccess: Input/output safety limits saved. Restart Hermes Gateway to take effect.
engine.hermesIoSafetyFootnote: Defaults fit most models. Lower these limits for small-context models. Other advanced tool_output fields are preserved in raw YAML.
engine.hermesCheckpointsConfigDesc: Create a working-directory snapshot before the first file write or patch so long runs can recover with /rollback after accidental edits.
engine.hermesCheckpointsConfigSaveSuccess: File checkpoint rollback settings saved. Restart Hermes Gateway to take effect.
engine.hermesCheckpointsConfigLoadFailed: Load file checkpoint rollback settings failed
engine.hermesCheckpointsConfigSaveFailed: Save file checkpoint rollback settings failed
engine.hermesCheckpointsConfigFootnote: This writes checkpoints.*. Set total size cap or single-file cap to 0 to disable that limit. Other advanced checkpoint fields stay in raw YAML.
engine.hermesCronConfigDesc: Control whether scheduled job results are wrapped with task context, and cap jobs running in parallel per tick to reduce unattended-run noise and resource spikes.
engine.hermesCronConfigSaveSuccess: Cron job output settings saved. Restart Hermes Gateway to take effect.
engine.hermesCronConfigLoadFailed: Load cron job output settings failed
engine.hermesCronConfigSaveFailed: Save cron job output settings failed
engine.hermesCronConfigWrapResponse: Add job name and system notice when delivering results
engine.hermesCronConfigFootnote: This writes cron.wrap_response and cron.max_parallel_jobs. Set parallel jobs to 0 for no extra cap; Hermes writes null to match upstream semantics. Other advanced cron fields stay in raw YAML.
engine.hermesLoggingConfigDesc: Control Hermes log level, per-file rotation size, retained backups, and Gateway memory sampling for easier long-run diagnosis without unbounded logs.
engine.hermesLoggingConfigSaveSuccess: Runtime log settings saved. Restart Hermes Gateway to take effect.
engine.hermesLoggingConfigMaxSizeMb: Max size per log file MB
engine.hermesLoggingConfigFootnote: This writes logging.* and logging.memory_monitor.*. Other advanced logging fields stay in raw YAML. Lower log levels are more detailed and may increase disk usage.
engine.hermesApprovalsConfigDesc: Control approval policy for dangerous commands, cron jobs, and destructive slash commands so unattended long runs do not approve risky operations by mistake.
engine.hermesApprovalsConfigSaveSuccess: Approval safety settings saved. Restart Hermes Gateway to take effect.
engine.hermesApprovalsConfigFootnote: Manual or smart interactive approval is recommended, with cron jobs denying dangerous commands by default. Use default approval only in fully trusted unattended environments. Other advanced approvals fields stay in raw YAML.
engine.hermesPrivacyConfigDesc: Redact user IDs, phone numbers, and chat identifiers before supported Gateway channels send context to the model, reducing public-channel exposure risk.
engine.hermesPrivacyConfigSaveSuccess: Privacy redaction settings saved. Restart Hermes Gateway to take effect.
engine.hermesPrivacyConfigRedactPii: Redact user identifiers and phone numbers before model context
engine.hermesPrivacyConfigFootnote: Currently applies mainly to WhatsApp, Signal, and Telegram. Discord and Slack keep real user IDs to preserve mention semantics. Other advanced privacy fields are preserved in raw YAML.
engine.hermesBrowserConfigDesc: Control browser-tool idle cleanup, per-command timeout, session recording, and local engine to reduce stuck long-run browsing tasks and accidental recording risk.
engine.hermesBrowserConfigSaveSuccess: Browser tool settings saved. Restart Hermes Gateway to take effect.
engine.hermesBrowserConfigAutoLocalForPrivateUr: Use local browser automatically for private URLs
engine.hermesBrowserConfigCdpUrlPlaceholder: Leave empty to launch browser automatically
engine.hermesBrowserConfigFootnote: Lightpanda navigates faster but does not support screenshots. Recording writes WebM files into the Hermes browser_recordings directory, so enable it only for audits. Empty CDP URL means Hermes launches a browser automatically. Camofox identity fields only affect the Camofox backend; user_id / session_key reuse a remote profile or session and do not store passwords or API keys. Existing-tab adoption only works when the Camofox service returns tabs.
engine.hermesWebConfigDesc: Control default and per-capability backends for web_search / web_extract. This stores backend choices only, not API keys.
engine.hermesWebConfigSaveSuccess: Web tool backend settings saved. Restart Hermes Gateway to take effect.
engine.hermesWebConfigFootnote: This writes web.backend, web.search_backend, and web.extract_backend. Leaving a value empty removes the override so Hermes can auto-select based on keys, available providers, and upstream defaults. Unknown web fields stay in raw YAML.
engine.hermesModelCatalogConfigDesc: Control Hermes model catalog fetching, cache TTL, and provider-specific catalog overrides so model selection stays usable with network issues or private mirrors.
engine.hermesModelCatalogConfigSaveSuccess: Model catalog settings saved. Restart Hermes Gateway to take effect.
engine.hermesModelCatalogConfigFootnote: This writes model_catalog.enabled, model_catalog.url, model_catalog.ttl_hours, and model_catalog.providers. providers must be a JSON object, provider names may contain letters, numbers, underscores, dots, and hyphens only, and each provider url must use http or https. Unknown model_catalog fields stay in raw YAML.
engine.hermesXSearchConfigDesc: Control the Hermes x_search tool model, timeout, and retry count. This manages runtime parameters only and does not store xAI credentials.
engine.hermesXSearchConfigSaveSuccess: X Search settings saved. Restart Hermes Gateway to take effect.
engine.hermesXSearchConfigFootnote: This writes x_search.model, x_search.timeout_seconds, and x_search.retries. xAI OAuth or XAI_API_KEY is still read by the Hermes runtime; the x_search toolset must be enabled before the tool is called. Unknown x_search fields stay in raw YAML.
engine.hermesContextConfigDesc: Control whether Hermes uses the built-in compressor or a plugin context engine when approaching the context window limit. Useful for long-session stability tuning.
engine.hermesContextConfigSaveSuccess: Context engine settings saved. Restart Hermes Gateway to take effect.
engine.hermesContextConfigFootnote: This writes context.engine. compressor uses the built-in compressor; entering a plugin name makes Hermes try plugins/context_engine/<name>/ or user plugin directories. Unknown context fields stay in raw YAML.
engine.hermesLspConfigDesc: Control language-server diagnostic waits, workspace scans, and missing-server install strategy after file writes and patches.
engine.hermesLspConfigSaveSuccess: LSP semantic diagnostic settings saved. Restart Hermes Gateway to take effect.
engine.hermesLspConfigLoadFailed: Load LSP semantic diagnostic settings failed
engine.hermesLspConfigSaveFailed: Save LSP semantic diagnostic settings failed
engine.hermesLspConfigFootnote: This writes lsp.enabled, lsp.wait_mode, lsp.wait_timeout, and lsp.install_strategy. Advanced lsp.servers overrides stay in raw YAML. Whether remote or sandbox backends trigger host LSP depends on the Hermes runtime cwd and Git workspace detection.
engine.hermesSttConfigDesc: Control automatic voice-message transcription for messaging platforms, plus local, OpenAI, and Mistral transcription models. Useful for channels that receive voice feedback.
engine.hermesSttConfigSaveSuccess: Speech transcription settings saved. Restart Hermes Gateway to take effect.
engine.hermesSttConfigFootnote: This writes stt.*. API keys are still managed through .env. Groq uses the upstream default model, and other provider advanced fields stay in raw YAML.
engine.hermesTtsVoiceConfigDesc: Control Hermes TTS providers and common voice models, plus CLI recording hotkey and silence auto-stop.
engine.hermesTtsVoiceConfigSaveSuccess: Speech output settings saved. Restart Hermes Gateway or CLI sessions to take effect.
engine.hermesTtsVoiceConfigFootnote: This writes tts.* and voice.*. API keys are still managed through .env. Empty optional voice IDs remove overrides and fall back to Hermes/provider defaults. Advanced provider fields and max_text_length stay in raw YAML.
engine.hermesCompressionDesc: Control when long conversations are compressed, the target size, and protected message ranges to reduce failures and wasted cost from oversized context.
engine.hermesCompressionSaveSuccess: Compression settings saved. Restart Hermes Gateway to take effect.
engine.hermesCompressionFootnote: Lower thresholds and target ratios compress earlier and more aggressively. Start with the defaults, then tune with real Gateway logs.
engine.hermesPromptCachingConfigDesc: Control the Anthropic/OpenRouter prefix cache TTL. For long runs with longer pauses between turns, choose 1 hour to reduce repeated context cost.
engine.hermesPromptCachingConfigSaveSuccess: Prompt caching settings saved. Restart Hermes Gateway to take effect.
engine.hermesPromptCachingConfigFootnote: This writes prompt_caching.cache_ttl. Upstream only supports 5m and 1h; other advanced prompt_caching fields stay in raw YAML.
engine.hermesOpenrouterCacheConfigDesc: Control OpenRouter response caching. For long runs and repeated debugging of similar tasks, enabling it can reduce repeated request cost.
engine.hermesOpenrouterCacheConfigSaveSuccess: OpenRouter response caching saved. Restart Hermes Gateway to take effect.
engine.hermesOpenrouterCacheConfigFootnote: This writes openrouter.response_cache and openrouter.response_cache_ttl. Other advanced OpenRouter fields stay in raw YAML.
engine.hermesProviderRoutingConfigDesc: Set OpenRouter provider sorting, allowlist, blocklist, and privacy preferences to control cost, speed, and availability.
engine.hermesProviderRoutingConfigSaveSuccess: OpenRouter routing policy saved. Restart Hermes Gateway to take effect.
engine.hermesProviderRoutingConfigOnly: Only use these providers (one per line)
engine.hermesProviderRoutingConfigRequireParame: Only choose providers that support current parameters
engine.hermesProviderRoutingConfigFootnote: This writes provider_routing.sort, only, ignore, order, require_parameters, and data_collection. Unknown fields stay in raw YAML.
engine.hermesAuxiliaryConfigDesc: Assign separate models for image analysis, web extraction, and session search so these tasks do not compete with the main chat model.
engine.hermesAuxiliaryConfigSaveSuccess: Auxiliary model settings saved. Restart Hermes Gateway to take effect.
engine.hermesAuxiliaryConfigFootnote: This writes auxiliary.vision, auxiliary.web_extract, and auxiliary.session_search. extra_body, custom tasks, and unknown fields stay in raw YAML.
engine.hermesToolGuardrailsDesc: Warn the model when tools repeat failures or make no progress. Enable hard stops to halt runaway loops before they spend the full turn budget.
engine.hermesToolGuardrailsSaveSuccess: Tool loop guardrails saved. Restart Hermes Gateway to take effect.
engine.hermesToolGuardrailsFootnote: By default Hermes only warns and does not block, which fits interactive use. Hard stops are better for cron, unattended, and long-running background jobs.

ciaoBug.toastTitle: 알려진 문제 감지: Windows에서 OpenClaw 실행 시 15초마다 cmd 창이 깜박임
ciaoBug.modalTitle: Windows cmd 팝업 — 서드파티 라이브러리 버그
ciaoBug.summary: 이것은 OpenClaw가 의존하는 @homebridge/ciao 라이브러리의 알려진 버그이며 ClawPanel이나 OpenClaw 자체의 문제가 아닙니다. ciao는 15~30초마다 "arp -a"를 호출하여 네트워크 인터페이스 캐시를 갱신하는데 windowsHide 옵션을 지정하지 않아 Windows에서 cmd 창이 순간적으로 깜박입니다. 기능 자체는 정상이며 시각적 방해일 뿐입니다.
ciaoBug.fixUpstream: 업스트림 병합 대기 —— PR #65에 이미 수정이 올라와 있지만 병합되지 않았습니다. OpenClaw가 ciao 의존성을 업데이트하면 자동으로 사라집니다.
ciaoBug.fixPatchPackage: patch-package로 OpenClaw에 패치 적용: OpenClaw 소스 저장소(또는 npm 전역 설치 디렉터리의 openclaw 패키지 디렉터리)에서 NetworkManager.js의 exec 호출에 { windowsHide: true }를 추가한 뒤 npx patch-package @homebridge/ciao를 실행하세요.
ciaoBug.fixManual: NetworkManager.js 수동 편집(가장 간단하지만 openclaw 업그레이드 후 다시 해야 함): 위 경로의 파일을 편집기로 열고 6개의 child_process.exec("arp ...") 호출을 찾아 URL 인수와 콜백 사이에 { windowsHide: true },를 추가한 후 저장하고 Gateway를 재시작하세요.
ciaoBug.disclaimer: 참고: ClawPanel은 node_modules를 자동으로 수정하는 대신 "감지하고 알리는" 방식을 선택했습니다 — 로컬 소프트웨어에 대한 사용자의 통제권을 존중합니다.

modelChannels.title: Model Channels
modelChannels.desc: Maintain model access (base URL, API key, models) in one place and sync it to OpenClaw, Hermes, DeepSeek Harness, OpenCode, and the assistant.
modelChannels.localOnlyHint: Channels are stored locally; keys are always masked when read.
modelChannels.empty: No channels yet. Create one, or import from your existing OpenClaw model config.
modelChannels.how1: Create a channel: pick a provider preset or custom, fill in the base URL and API key, then fetch or type the models
modelChannels.how2: Click "Sync to…" to push the channel to OpenClaw / Hermes / DSH / OpenCode / the assistant — no more duplicate setup
modelChannels.how3: Re-sync after editing a channel; target configs are backed up automatically before writes
modelChannels.name: Channel Name
modelChannels.presetHint: Picking a preset fills in the base URL and API type
modelChannels.apiKeyHint: Leave empty to keep the saved key
modelChannels.modelsHint: One model ID per line, or click "Fetch Models" to pull the list
modelChannels.fetchOk: Fetched {count} models and merged them into the list
modelChannels.fetchEmpty: The provider returned no recognizable models; please type them manually
modelChannels.fetchNeedInput: Fill in the base URL and API key first
modelChannels.contextWindowHint: Applies to every model in this channel and can override an auto-detected 50000 limit from LM Studio.
modelChannels.maxTokensHint: Leave blank to preserve per-model values; a value overrides all models.
modelChannels.deleteConfirm: Delete channel "{name}"? Configs already synced to OpenClaw / Hermes / DeepSeek Harness / OpenCode / the assistant will not be removed.
modelChannels.baseUrlRequired: Base URL must start with http:// or https://
modelChannels.syncOpenclawConfirm: This writes provider "{key}" with {count} models into the OpenClaw model config. A backup is created first; other providers and unknown fields are untouched.
modelChannels.syncHermesConfirm: This writes the API key into the Hermes env var {env} (provider: {provider}). Config is backed up before writes.
modelChannels.syncHermesUnsupported: This API type cannot be synced to Hermes yet (OpenAI / Anthropic / Gemini compatible only)
modelChannels.syncDshConfirm: This writes the provider, credential reference, and {count} models through local 127.0.0.1:{port}, then verifies the result by reading it back.
modelChannels.syncDshUnsupported: DeepSeek Harness sync currently supports OpenAI Completions / Responses and Anthropic Messages.
modelChannels.syncOpenCodeConfirm: This writes {count} models to OpenCode's isolated config and credential file. Other providers and manual settings are preserved.
modelChannels.syncOpenCodeUnsupported: This API type cannot be synced to OpenCode yet.
modelChannels.syncAssistantConfirm: This copies the channel base URL and API key to the assistant (model: {model}). Re-sync after future edits.
modelChannels.syncAssistantUnsupported: The assistant does not support this API type yet
modelChannels.syncSetDefaultAsk: Also set "{model}" as the default model?
modelChannels.noKeyForSync: The channel has no saved API key; sync aborted

deepseekHarness.title: DeepSeek Harness
deepseekHarness.desc: Manage the local Harness Web runtime and sync providers, API keys, context windows, and default models from Model Channels.
deepseekHarness.developerPreview: The upstream project is still a Developer Preview. ClawPanel pins a verified version and requires re-validation before upgrades.
deepseekHarness.workspaceDesc: The native Web UI is securely embedded for chat, model switching, and session management.
deepseekHarness.workspacePageDesc: Dedicated workspace for chat, model switching, and session management
deepseekHarness.workspaceUnavailableDesc: Install and start Harness from Runtime & Configuration, then the workspace will load here.
deepseekHarness.workspaceFailed: Failed to load the Harness workspace
deepseekHarness.installConfirm: Use pnpm to install pinned version {version} from the npm registry into ClawPanel's local runtime directory? This does not install globally or modify Harness source.
deepseekHarness.stopConfirm: Stop the DeepSeek Harness process started by ClawPanel?
deepseekHarness.uninstallConfirm: Delete the DeepSeek Harness runtime managed by ClawPanel? Harness settings and ClawPanel Model Channels are preserved.
deepseekHarness.portHint: Listens on 127.0.0.1 only. Restart Harness after changing it.
deepseekHarness.nodeIncompatible: Current Node.js does not satisfy {requirement}. Upgrade Node.js first.
deepseekHarness.foreignPort: The port is occupied by another service and Harness did not respond.
deepseekHarness.externalStopHint: This process was not started by ClawPanel. The panel detects it read-only and will not terminate it.
deepseekHarness.loopbackDesc: Harness still listens only on 127.0.0.1. Web deployments embed the full UI through a sandboxed proxy with a short-lived capability that cannot call ClawPanel APIs; panel cookies and credentials are never forwarded upstream.
deepseekHarness.remoteUiHint: Remote Web embeds Harness through the panel security proxy; no additional public port is required.

openCode.title: OpenCode
openCode.desc: Manage the local OpenCode Web runtime and sync providers, API keys, context windows, and default models from Model Channels.
openCode.developerPreview: OpenCode is managed independently by ClawPanel. Online updates install into staging, switch atomically after validation, and restore the previous runtime on failure.
openCode.workspacePageDesc: Dedicated workspace for coding, model switching, and session management
openCode.workspaceUnavailableDesc: Install and start OpenCode from Runtime & Configuration, then the workspace will load here.
openCode.workspaceAuthRestart: This instance was started by the Web runtime with service authentication. Stop and restart it from the runtime page to load it directly in the desktop workspace.
openCode.workspaceFailed: Failed to load the OpenCode workspace
openCode.installConfirm: Install pinned version {version} from npm into ClawPanel's local runtime directory? This does not install globally or modify OpenCode source.
openCode.stopConfirm: Stop the OpenCode process started by ClawPanel?
openCode.updateConfirm: Update OpenCode online from {current} to {latest}? If it is running, the panel will stop it and restart it after the update.
openCode.uninstallConfirm: Uninstall the OpenCode runtime managed by ClawPanel? A running service will be stopped automatically, while configuration, credentials, and workspace are preserved.
openCode.portHint: Listens on 127.0.0.1 only. Restart OpenCode after changing it.
openCode.foreignPort: The port is occupied by another service and OpenCode did not respond.
openCode.externalStopHint: This process was not started by ClawPanel. The panel detects it read-only and will not terminate it.
openCode.desktopRestartHint: This instance was started by the Web runtime with service authentication. Stop and restart it here before entering the desktop workspace.
openCode.loopbackDesc: OpenCode listens only on 127.0.0.1 and uses a random service password. Web deployments embed it through a sandboxed proxy with a short-lived capability; the OpenCode port stays private and panel cookies are not forwarded upstream.
